challenge.method: Compare the text grammar and binary decoding, the optional source-file wrapper, and the independent parser’s separate module and script entry points. Check whether decoding or parsing entails semantic validation.
challenge.results: Well-formed concrete input is determined by its edition grammar, and module validation is separate. A test script can wrap or operate on module forms without becoming a core module representation. A deliberately unresolved start index passes the binary field encoding but fails the current runtime validation probe.

limitations: This concerns encoding or parsing a core module. A well-formed encoding is separate from module validation. The source-file wrapper abbreviation and testing-tool commands have different scopes.
Exact dated publications govern the scope. The independently constructed current-engine cases are a supplementary challenge.
